cases.note: an empty graph and an unknown entity give empty answers; the same triple twice is one fact, a new relation or the reverse direction is another
a fact joins the network at one more than the distance of its nearer end, so a fact between two nodes at distance k appears at k + 1 hops
rows are sorted by hop and then as text: digits before underscore before letters, a shorter text before a longer one it starts
a fact whose subject and object are the same node is found from that node, and counts the node once
walks go against the arrows as well, a node reached two ways is as near as the shorter way, and the hop limit cuts the chain
a hub is near everything that touches it, in either direction, and two disjoint parts never meet
a random graph of 60 nodes and 150 facts, asked from several nodes at several depths
the age is whole half-lives: 9 days is none, 10 is one; a fact from the future has age 0; after four halvings the factor stops falling
each hop halves the score down to a factor of 1 at the fifth hop, and a weight of 1 gives the smallest scores
equal scores go to the nearer fact, then to the smaller subject, relation and object
the ranking depends on the time asked: the same graph ranks differently now and later
a fact outside the hop limit is not ranked, however heavy; an unknown entity has nothing to rank
a fact added again keeps its first weight and time, and the ranking shows it
a budget of 0 takes nothing; a fact that does not fit is skipped and a smaller one after it still goes in
the token count is the characters of subject, relation and object plus 2, divided by 4 and rounded up: 8 characters make 2 tokens, 9 make 3, 12 make 3, 13 make 4
a fact bigger than the whole budget is never taken, even when it ranks first; the used tokens never pass the budget
the choice follows the ranking, so it changes with the time, the depth and the half-life, and a call changes nothing
equal scores are filled in the order of the text, and facts with the same score and size all fit or not by that order
a filled budget on the random graph: depth, time and half-life as in a real call
